digest.component_or_area: LLM code-review criteria routing and thresholds
propositions: Four LLM code-review criteria (api-compat, deletion-impact, regression, error-handling) must be flipped from advisory to blocking at calibrated thresholds (0.51, 0.60, 0.54, 0.50 respectively) based on code-v3 corpus validation (1760 sidecars, 1173 changes, 4359 findings).

The approved blocking criterion set must expand from 3 members (secret-detection, high-critical-security, security) to exactly 7 members, enforced by three governance-pin tests that deliberate re-approve any future additions.

Regression and error-handling are added as base-reviewer dimension entries (not content-triggered overlays) with inert exec/applies_to fields, consulted only for posture/threshold/blocking_enabled resolution by registry.threshold_for.
All four criteria must include _comment annotations citing the ticket and code-v3 calibration analysis in criteria_routing.json before Gerrit landing.
